summary: Reproduced the default profiler's speculative stage misclassification and synchronous trace export in focused tests. TARGET_VERIFY was counted as prefill, DRAFT_EXTEND_V2 was rejected, and a blocked export blocked _stop_profile. Speculative steps now count as decode, and the default profiler exports, performs its export barrier, and optionally merges traces on a tracked background thread after synchronously stopping collection.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: TARGET_VERIFY incremented prefill, DRAFT_EXTEND_V2 raised unsupported profile stage, and synchronous export held _stop_profile for the export fixture's 5 second timeout. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-12936fe13f1a/evidence/failing-before.txt

4 passed plus 2 speculative-mode subtests; 10 MLX-only tests skipped. Covers TARGET_VERIFY and DRAFT_EXTEND_V2 decode classification, unchanged EXTEND/DECODE boundaries, profile-v2 classification, and nonblocking default-profiler export. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-12936fe13f1a/evidence/final-tests.txt

A real single-rank ROCm torch-profiler run through SchedulerProfilerManager generated gfx950-TP-0.trace.json.gz (42,211 bytes). A 256x256 GPU matmul had max absolute error 3.0517578125e-05 against the CPU reference. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-12936fe13f1a/evidence/gpu-profiler.txt; trace: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-12936fe13f1a/gpu-profile/gfx950-TP-0.trace.json.gz
No whitespace errors in the delivered patch. Ruff and Black were unavailable in the prepared interpreter.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) executed a profiled matrix multiplication and exported a nonempty trace; retained paths are listed in tests.

remaining_limitations: No B200, TP8, GLM-5.2 weights, or multi-node resources were available, so the reported 25 second export duration and full serving TTFT impact were not reproduced.
The single-gfx950 fixture validates the manager's GPU collection/export path and numerical execution only; it does not qualify EAGLE/MTP model semantics or distributed behavior.
SGLANG_PROFILE_V2 is disabled by default. Its speculative stage mapping is fixed here, but its separate exporter remains synchronous and was not redesigned in this narrow correction.
The background export barrier was validated at world size one; multi-rank completion and optional trace merging are covered structurally but were not executed on this single-GPU assignment.
